newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Erdos plans to issue new B shares.
newsitem.headline: Erdos plans to issue new B shares.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd plans to issue 70-100 million new B shares by March 1997, an official involved in the offer told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin on Wednesday.

An official at China Southern Securities, the domestic lead underwriter for the offer, said the second tranche of the B share offer would be priced at a minimum of US$0.469 per share, the level of the cashmere producer's first tranche of B shares.
The official said Erdos aimed to use proceeds from the new issue to expand its scale of operations and supplement working capital used to buy cashmere.
Erdos was selecting an international coordinator for the offer, the official said, adding that the plan required approval from Erdos's shareholders and the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
Erdos listed 110 million B shares on the Shanghai stock exchange last October.
